Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Substantive bounded primary methods/results/limitations source review is documented at 2603.04370v1. Gold-document solvability audits and user-simulator limitations establish knowledge/tool benchmark construction. Tau-Knowledge paper identity is not automatically a new tau3-Banking family. Original author/source-verifier/adversarial receipts bind every exact approved fact; unread pages, unreplicated experiments and source conflicts remain recorded in the pinned dossier. This admission is for one logical paper work only.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The user simulator omits many characteristics of real human variation; latency depends on API serving, and unrestricted repeated search may differ from deployments allowing only one or a few searches.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Tau-Knowledge builds a structured fictional banking knowledge base, converts it to unstructured documents and co-constructs tasks/tools with human refinement; two reviewers independent of task creation check final states, minimal gold documents and one valid trajectory per task.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The tau-Banking domain contains 97 tasks, 698 documents, 51 discoverable tools and 14 permanently available agent tools; its knowledge base spans 21 categories and 194, 562 tokens under the stated tokenizer.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Table 2 reports GPT-5.2 High pass^1 of 25.52% with terminal search and 32.73% with gold documents directly in context; Claude 4.5 Opus High reaches 39.69% in the gold setting. Here pass^k requires success in every one ofk trials.
